jobs.title: Python & VBA Developer
Full Stack Developer - C#/.NET (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
**Herzlich Willkommen in der HÖRMANNschaft!**

**HÖRMANN Intralogistics** ist als Teil der Hörmann Gruppe seit 1987 Generalunternehmer und Experte für automatisierte Lagerlösungen und begleitende Dienstleistungen.

Mit modernster Robotik, Fördertechnik und unserem flexiblen Warehouse Management System bieten wir effiziente Materialflusssysteme aus einer Hand. Unsere Standorte in verschiedenen Ländern garantieren persönliche Kundenbetreuung, Zuverlässigkeit, Qualität und umfassenden Service.

Gemeinschaftliches Vorankommen, voneinander Lernen und gegenseitige Unterstützung in einem familiären Umfeld sind Teil des Erfolgsrezepts. Was wir machen, begeistert uns – und Begeisterung steckt an.

**WMS bei HÖRMANN**

Du willst Software nicht nur entwickeln, sondern sehen, wie sie im Lageralltag funktioniert?

Als Full Stack Projektentwickler WMS (m/w/d) verbindest du moderne Softwareentwicklung mit anspruchsvollen Intralogistikprojekten. Du übersetzt Kundenanforderungen in durchdachte technische Lösungen, entwickelst individuelle Erweiterungen und begleitest unsere WMS Projekte bis zur Inbetriebnahme. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Kunden, Projektmanagement, Service und Entwicklung zusammen.

**Deine Rolle im Team**

* **WMS Projekte:** Du entwickelst und realisierst kundenspezifische WMS Lösungen auf Basis fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen.
* **Technische Beratung:** Du klärst Anforderungen in Workshops und berätst unsere Kunden zu Funktionen, APIs und Schnittstellen.
* **Full Stack Entwicklung:** Du entwickelst mit C# und .NET individuelle Erweiterungen und integrierst sie nachhaltig in unser Standardprodukt.
* **Sauberer Code:** Du entwickelst wiederverwendbaren, skalierbaren und wartbaren Code über verschiedene Anwendungsschichten hinweg.
* **Qualität im Blick:** Du sicherst deine Entwicklungen mit automatisierten Unit und Integrationstests ab und bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein.
* **Go Live:** Du installierst und konfigurierst unsere Software in Kundenumgebungen und unterstützt bei Inbetriebnahmen vor Ort, mit rund 10 Prozent Reisetätigkeit.

**Dein Profil im Fokus**

* **C# und .NET:** Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in C# und arbeitest sicher mit .NET 10.
* **Full Stack Know how:** Du bringst Erfahrung mit ASP.NET Core, Blazor und Entity Framework Core sowie Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS und JavaScript mit.
* **APIs und Integration:** Du kennst dich mit REST APIs sowie Swagger und OpenAPI aus und kannst Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen technisch konzipieren.
* **Testing und CI:** Du hast Erfahrung mit xUnit, automatisierten Tests, Continuous Integration und Git Source Control.
* **Softwarequalität:** Du entwickelst nach Clean Code Prinzipien und kennst dich mit Softwarearchitektur, Design Patterns und SOLID aus.
* **WMS Verständnis:** Du bringst Erfahrung aus der Intralogistik mit und kannst fachliche Anforderungen in passende technische Lösungen übersetzen.
* **Analytisches Denken:** Du gehst komplexe technische Fragestellungen strukturiert an und findest pragmatische, nachhaltige Lösungen.
* **Kundenkommunikation:** Du trittst im direkten Kundenkontakt sicher auf und kannst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln.
* **Team und Sprache:** Du arbeitest gerne agil und im Team und kommunizierst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch.

**Freu Dich auf**

* **Flexible Arbeitszeiten:** Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel und profitiere von der Möglichkeit, Arbeit und Privatleben optimal zu vereinbaren.
* **Mobiles Arbeiten:** Nutze die Option, von zu Hause aus oder unterwegs zu arbeiten, um deine Produktivität und Work-Life-Balance zu steigern.
* **Sicherer Arbeitsplatz:** Wir bieten dir eine langfristige Perspektive in einem stabilen und familiären Unternehmensumfeld.
* **Geförderte Weiterbildung:** Entwickle dich stetig weiter durch Zugang zu vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, die wir aktiv unterstützen und fördern und unsere internen „HÖRMANN Lernwelten“,
* **Gelebte Teamarbeit:** Erlebe eine offene und kooperative Arbeitskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, die schnelle Entscheidungswege und direkte Kommunikation fördert.
* **Zusätzliche Benefits:** Profitiere von zusätzlichen Angeboten wie der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge „HÖRMANN Rente“, Job-Rad und weiteren attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten.
* **Verpflegung im Office:** Genieße kostenlosen Kaffee, Erfrischungsgetränke und Obst als Flatrate, die wir in unseren Büros zur Verfügung stellen.

jobs.title: C# Developer - Redis
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

C# Developer - Redis

London (Hybrid, 3 Days On-Site)

Talan is looking for a talented and driven C# Redis Developer to join a high-performing team in London. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days per week on-site, offering the opportunity to work on cutting-edge financial systems within a global markets environment.

You will play a key role in building and enhancing a distributed, real-time P&L and risk analytics platform used by Fixed Income Rates and FX trading desks globally. This system delivers predictive and live P&L insights, supporting critical trading decisions across international markets.

Working closely with developers, traders, and quantitative teams, you’ll contribute across the full development lifecycle from design and implementation to optimisation and deployment.

What You’ll Be Doing

* Developing and maintaining scalable .NET/C# services within a distributed streaming architecture
* Building and supporting real-time data processing systems for P&L and risk analytics
* Working on out-of-process services, system integrations, and data materialisation layers
* Driving Agile best practices, including test-driven development (TDD) and automation
* Collaborating with global teams across EMEA, NY, and APAC
* Taking ownership of features and proactively proposing improvements
* Troubleshooting issues and helping unblock cross-team dependencies

Essential Skills & Experience

* Strong expertise in C# / .NET development
* Experience with Redis Cluster
* Solid understanding of TDD and automated testing
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
* Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies
* Passion for automation, simplicity, and continuous improvement
* Strong grounding in computer science fundamentals and design patterns
* Collaborative team player with a proactive mindset

Desirable Skills

* Experience with distributed systems, streaming, and messaging (e.g. Rx .NET)
* Knowledge of performance and memory profiling
* Experience optimising systems for speed and efficiency
* Familiarity with modern CI/CD tools and practices
* End-to-end experience across the full software development lifecycle

  
**Additional Information**

jobs.title: O&M Engineer
jobs.description:
At **Project Better Energy**, we're on a mission to make renewable energy accessible to everyone. As the home of **Project Solar UK, Project EV, Project CÜRV, Photon Energy, and ELCO Group**, we're proud to be driving innovation across the renewable energy sector.

We're looking for an experienced and motivated **O&M Engineer** to join our growing **Operations & Maintenance Team** at **Photon Energy Ltd**. This is an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of the renewable energy industry, supporting the performance and reliability of solar PV and electrical systems across a diverse portfolio of sites.

If you're a technically skilled engineer with a passion for renewable energy and problem-solving, we'd love to hear from you.

**Why Join Project Better Energy?**

**Salary:** From £40,000 per annum

**Location:** Hybrid role covering Reading (RG1 2TH) office and site-based work

**Hours:** Monday to Friday, 37.5 hours per week

**Holiday:** 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

**Additional Benefits:**

* Company vehicle and fuel card (where applicable)
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
* MetLife GP24 virtual healthcare
* PowerPerks employee discount platform
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* Learning Management System (LMS)
* Apprenticeship and development programmes
* Pension Salary Exchange Scheme
* Daintree Wealth Management financial guidance
* Enhanced maternity benefits
* Free eye tests
* Optional private healthcare scheme

**About the Role**

As an O&M Engineer, you'll play a vital role in ensuring renewable energy systems operate safely, efficiently, and at peak performance. This is a varied position that combines hands-on site work with technical planning and coordination responsibilities.

You'll work closely with clients, subcontractors, and internal teams to deliver exceptional service while supporting the long-term performance of solar PV and electrical installations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Carry out planned preventative maintenance inspections on renewable energy systems and associated equipment.
* Respond to and resolve reactive maintenance issues in a safe, professional, and timely manner.
* Conduct site inspections, surveys, and performance assessments.
* Complete remedial works identified during maintenance visits and inspections.
* Produce accurate site reports and maintenance documentation.
* Prepare and maintain maintenance schedules, service records, and site documentation packs.
* Liaise with internal teams to obtain quotations and recommendations for corrective works.
* Coordinate with clients, subcontractors, and colleagues to ensure projects are delivered efficiently.
* Manage maintenance activities and ensure service levels are achieved.
* Ensure all work is completed in accordance with company quality standards and health and safety procedures.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance and customer satisfaction.

**What We're Looking For**

**Essential Qualifications & Experience**

* 2382-22 Level 3 Award in the Requirements for Electrical Installations (BS 7671:2018) or higher.
* BTEC Level 4 or above in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* Strong technical knowledge of solar PV systems and electrical installations.
* Experience installing, servicing, or maintaining solar PV systems.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and AutoCAD.
* Full UK driving licence.
* Strong fault-finding and diagnostic abilities.
* Excellent communication and organisational skills.

**Why This Role?**

This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast-growing renewable energy business where you'll work on innovative projects, develop your technical expertise, and make a meaningful contribution to the UK's net-zero future.

Join us and be part of a company that's helping shape the future of sustainable energy.

*At Project Better Energy, we value diversity of thought, background and experience. We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment practices and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates. All hiring decisions are made on merit and capability.*

Pay: £40,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Reading RG1 2TH: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Application question(s):

* Do you have a Mechanical or Electrical Engineer Degree or Equivalent?
* Basic understanding of Renewable Energy and Solar PV Systems

Education:

* Bachelor's (required)

Experience:

* Microsoft Office: 1 year (required)
* AutoCAD: 1 year (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Reading RG1 2TH

jobs.title: ERP Systems Developer & Support
jobs.description:
Established in 1986, OE Electrics designs and manufactures innovative power solutions from its headquarters in Wakefield, West Yorkshire.

We are looking for an **ERP Systems Developer & Support** professional to join our Transformation Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in developing, supporting, and enhancing business-critical systems that drive efficiency and support growth across the organisation.

**The Role**

Working closely with the ERP Systems Manager, you will help develop and maintain software solutions that improve business processes and maximise the effectiveness of our ERP systems.

This role offers the opportunity to build expertise in ERP systems, SAP Business One, manufacturing processes, SQL Server development, software integrations, and solution design while working closely with experienced technical and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Development & Support: Assist in developing, testing, and deploying software enhancements and integrations based on design specifications.
* System Maintenance: Support and maintain ERP-related applications and databases to ensure business-critical systems remain robust and operational.
* Technical Problem Solving: Investigate and resolve user support queries, providing technical support to users and escalating complex issues when necessary.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with colleagues across finance, sales, manufacturing, and supply chain to understand operational needs and deliver practical technical solutions.
* Documentation & Quality: Follow established development standards and maintain clear documentation to support continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

**Essential Skills**

* Commercial Experience: Commercial software development experience, relevant apprenticeship experience, or equivalent practical experience.
* Core Technologies: Practical exposure to C#, Microsoft .NET, and Microsoft SQL.
* Problem-Solving Mindset: An inquisitive, analytical nature with a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical business colleagues.
* Organization: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple support and development tasks effectively.

**Desirable**

* Experience with SAP Business One or the SAP SDK.
* Background or interest in a manufacturing environment.
* Prior technical support or helpdesk experience.
* Good time-estimation skills and commercial/business awareness.

**About Our Systems Environment**

The role supports and develops solutions around our SAP Business One ERP platform and associated systems used across the business, including:

* Finance, purchasing and stock management
* Production, BOMs and MRP
* CRM and sales order processing
* Manufacturing Execution System
* SQL databases and stored procedures
* Web-based applications developed in-house
* Azure-hosted document storage
* System integrations and automated business processes across multiple international operations

**What's in It for You?**

* Competitive salary
* Christmas shutdown period
* Contributory pension scheme
* Free onsite parking
* Electric vehicle charging points
* Onsite gym and fitness classes
* Free hot drinks
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Chocolate Fridays!

**Additional Benefits**

* Company events
* Cycle to Work scheme
* Sick pay

**Location & Eligibility**

**Location:** Wakefield WF4 3GH (office-based role)

Applicants must have the right to work in the United Kingdom and be able to reliably commute to, or relocate to, the Wakefield area.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: £35,000.00-£45,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company events
* Company pension
* Cycle to work scheme
* Free fitness classes
* Free parking
* On-site gym
* On-site parking
* Sick pay

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Wakefield WF4 3GH: reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: In person
